visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands with decorated nails holds three new smartphones in black, light green, and white in a retail environment. The camera zooms in on the large circular camera lenses of the white model. (2) The scene shifts to show a price display for Zenfone on a shelf, followed by a close-up of the back of the light green phone showing the brand name. (3) The video transitions to an outdoor urban setting at dusk, showing a long queue of people on wide concrete stairs next to a modern commercial building. (4) A young woman in a pink puffer jacket and patterned skirt holds a plush ferret-shaped microphone, interviewing various people in the queue, including a woman with a backpack, two young men, and a man carrying a small child in a carrier. (5) A fast montage follows, showing the phone's digital interface demonstrating AI tracking boxes around a person in a corridor, a text-heavy document summary page on screen, and several close-ups of the phone's camera housing. (6) The host stands in a brightly lit indoor electronics store holding the white phone, smiling and gesturing directly to the camera as she speaks.

The host's voice alternates with male and female interviewee voices in quick succession.
